TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN.description: Bot token from Telegram **@BotFather** for the main FairTurn manager bot.

TELEGRAM_WEBHOOK_SECRET.description: Generate a strong random secret for authenticating Telegram webhook deliveries.

MANAGED_BOT_ENCRYPTION_KEY.description: A random 32+ character key used to encrypt creator subagent bot tokens at rest.

MINDS_BUILDER_API_KEY.description: Builder API key for the FairTurn Mind from [Minds](https://hellominds.ai/).

MINDS_MIND_ID.description: UUID of the enabled FairTurn Mind, not its display name or email.

SUPABASE_URL.description: Optional Supabase project URL for longitudinal decision memory.

SUPABASE_SECRET_KEY.description: Optional server-only Supabase secret key. Never use a browser/public key here.

SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY.description: Legacy alternative to SUPABASE_SECRET_KEY; keep it server-only and leave it empty when using the newer key.

ADMIN_ACTION_SECRET.description: Random bearer secret protecting operator-only moderation and Minds routes.

CRON_SECRET.description: Random bearer secret protecting scheduled automation execution.
